entries.example: A rectangle has four right angles.
A circle is cut in half by its diameter.
Its two halves can be called semi-circles.
The radius of a circle is the distance from its centre to the circumference.
The radius of a circle is the distance from its centre to the circumference.
The two halves of a sphere can be called hemispheres.

note: Presentation is not a definition table: shapes (circle, triangle, square, pentagon, octagon, rectangle, oval, sphere, cube, pyramid, spiral) are picture labels with no printed definitions, so per rules they are excluded.
